text:
Grace Lin: FYI — all-hands at 11:00am PT today. Short agenda: 1) company health + MRR snapshot; 2) Hosted usage quota policy: rationale and customer-facing options; 3) Dedicated capacity GA notes; 4) Console cost controls demo; 5) live Q&A. If you have a single-line question drop it here or use the form: https://forms.redwood-inference/c/allhands-asks

Owen Park: I'll present the quota decision — quick note: this is meant to make costs predictable for customers and reduce noisy overages for infra.

Tasha Nguyen: question: how will this affect internal trial orgs used by SEs?

Owen Park: Trials get a generous grace allotment (90 days) and a clear billing opt-in after that. SE trial orgs marked as "internal" keep the old behavior until we finish the migration tooling. We'll publish an internal migration checklist.

Ben Rhodes: ops concern — we need an immediate rollback toggle and an alert when enforcement spikes >5% of orgs in a day. Tagging eng-sre for runbook updates.

Ivy (Legal): Please route customer notice drafts through legal. EU/UK customers will need longer notice windows; I can review language today if someone drops the draft here.

deploy-bot: Reminder: meeting starts in 12 minutes — join: https://meet.redwood-inference/allhands-3996547890

--- meeting held ---

Grace Lin: Thanks for joining. Recording uploaded: https://redwood-inference.company/recordings/allhands-3996547890. Slides + short notes: https://redwood-inference.company/slides/allhands-3996547890.pdf

Owen Park: Main points from my segment: pilot with a small cohort of partners; opt-in window for hosted customers for 30 days; soft-enforcement thereafter with an emailed notice and an in-console prompt. Dedicated unaffected. Migration API flags, rollback toggle, and monitoring spec will be published in the playbook.

Tasha Nguyen: follow-up: internal trials note appreciated — I'll coordinate with SE tools to tag internal orgs before the migration.

Ben Rhodes: ops action items: 1) create enforcement-spike alert (threshold: 5% day-over-day); 2) add rollback toggle to infra-control panel; 3) prepare runbook updates for eng-sre (due 2025-05-02).

Ivy (Legal): I'll review the customer notice by EOD Thursday and flag any region-specific legal requirements.

Grace Lin: Executive takeaways: keep latency and reliability investments steady; accelerate Private sales for regulated accounts; hiring ask summarized in slides (2 infra, 1 sales ops).

Owen Park: ACTIONS (short):
- Owen to publish migration playbook + API spec (Fri)
- Grace to send exec summary + hiring ask to board (Mon)
- Tasha to tag internal trial orgs and coordinate SE tooling (Wed)
- Ben to implement alerts + rollback toggle (2025-05-02)
- Ivy to approve customer notice copy (Thu)

Tasha Nguyen: follow-up: tagging plan started, will post checklist in #devex by EOD.

Ben Rhodes: follow-up: requested canary window with eng-sre (slot pending).

deploy-bot: Transcript and automated notes available: https://redwood-inference.company/transcripts/allhands-3996547890

Grace Lin: If you want a deeper follow-up reply with "follow-up: <topic>" and we'll assign an owner. Closing thread — playbook link will be posted in #product when live. :sparkles:
